title: How to use the hygiene cycle on a washing machine

pieces.say: Your washing machine has a secret germ setting.
pieces.text: Your washing machine has a secret germ setting.
pieces.label: HIDDEN SETTING

pieces.say: Here's the hidden setting. It's called Hygiene, or Allergy.
Check the labels. Bedding and towels that take sixty degrees.
Turn the dial to Hygiene or Allergy.
Dry it straight away, and leave the door open.
Follow your manual. One product only, never mix cleaners.
Fresher sheets, and fewer dust mites.

elevenlabsPrompt:
[playful] Your washing machine has a secret germ setting.

[intrigued] Here's the hidden setting. It's called Hygiene, or Allergy.

[friendly] Check the labels. Bedding and towels that take sixty degrees. Turn the dial to Hygiene or Allergy. Normal detergent only, then start. Dry it straight away, and leave the door open. Follow your manual. One product only, never mix cleaners.

[delighted] Fresher sheets, and fewer dust mites.

[warm] Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
